selection: Candidate identities and states fixed from literature before predictions. Full residue/region output retained, no successful site filtering.
primary_checkpoint: Current all-chain-family fold0 full model, pending exact checkpoint identity verification.
method: Independent absolute-state predictions; deltas computed only afterwards. No retraining or new MD.
Hchi_comparison: Exclude changed residue identity from Hchi deltas; A/G have no sidechain chi and proline eligibility reported. All positions retained in raw CSV.
evidence_limits: Counterfactual amino-acid replacement on a fixed backbone is only model sensitivity, not experimental mutant coordinates.
NMR millisecond exchange is qualitative external context, not the same numerical observable as RMSF/Hchi.
Two crystal copies are not simulation replicates.
Existing MD labels provide absolute-state checks only for their exact recorded input context.
